verse.verse_2: By the Qur'an full of wisdom.
verse.verse_3: Verily thou art of the sent ones,
verse.verse_5: This is a revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_6: That thou mayest warn a people whose fathers were not warned; so they are negligent.
verse.verse_7: Assuredly the word hath been justified against most of them, wherefore they shall not believe.
verse.verse_8: Verily We have placed on their necks shackles which are up to the chins; so that their heads are forced up.
verse.verse_9: And We have placed before them a barrier and behind them a barrier, so We have covered them, so that they see not.
verse.verse_10: And it is alike Unto them, whather thou warnest them or warnest them not; they shall not believe.
verse.verse_11: Thou canst warn only him who followeth the admonition and feareth the Compassionate, unseen. So bear thou Unto him the glad tidings of forgiveness and a generous hire.
verse.verse_12: Verily We! We shall guicken the dead. And We write down that which they send before and their footsteps. And everything We have counted up in a Book luminous.
verse.verse_13: And propound thou Unto them the similitude of the inhabitants of a town, When there came thereto the sent ones;
verse.verse_14: What time We sent Unto them two, then they belied the twain, wherefore We strengthened them with a third, and they said: verily we are Unto you the sent ones.
verse.verse_15: They said: ye are but human beings like ourselves; the Compassionate hath not sent down aught; ye are only lying.
verse.verse_16: They said: our Lord knoweth that we are surely Unto you the sent ones.
verse.verse_17: And on us is naught but manifest preaching.
verse.verse_18: They said: verily we augur ill of you; if ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and there will befall you from us a torment afflictive.
verse.verse_19: They said: your evil augury be with you. Call ye it an ill- luck because ye are admonished! Aye! ye are a people extravagant.
verse.verse_20: And there came from the farthest part of the town a man running. He said; O my people! follow the sent ones.
verse.verse_21: Follow those who ask not of you any hire, and who are rightly guided.
verse.verse_22: And what aileth me that I should not worship Him who hath created me, and Unto whom ye shall be returned.
verse.verse_23: Shall I take beside Him gods when, if the Compassionate should intend me any harm, their intercession will avail me not at all, nor would they save me?
verse.verse_24: Verily then I should be in error manifest.
verse.verse_25: Verily I believe now in your Lord; so hearken Unto me."
verse.verse_26: It was said: enter thou the Garden. He said: would that my people knew.
verse.verse_27: That my Lord hath forgiven me, and hath made me of the honoured ones.
verse.verse_28: And We sent not against his people after him a host from heaven, nor have We been sending down any such.
verse.verse_29: It was but one shout, and lo! they were extinct.
verse.verse_30: Ah the misery of the bondmen! there cometh not: Unto them an apostle but him they have been mocking.
verse.verse_31: Behold they not how many We have destroyed before them of the generations! verily Unto them they shall not return.
verse.verse_32: And surely all, every one of them, shall be brought before us.
verse.verse_33: And a sign Unto them is the dead land. We quicken it and therecut We bring forth grain, so that thereof they eat.
verse.verse_34: And We place therein gardens of the date-palms and vines; and We therein cause to gush forth springs.
verse.verse_35: That they may eat of the fruit thereof; and their hands worked it not. Will they not, therefore, give thanks?
verse.verse_36: Hallowed be He who hath created all the pairs of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves and of that which they know not!
verse.verse_37: And a sign Unto them is the night. We draw off the day therefrom, and lo! they are darkened.
verse.verse_38: And the sun runneth to its appointed term: that is the disposition of the Mighty, the Knowing."
verse.verse_39: And the moon! For it We have decreed mansions till it reverteth like the old branch of a palm-tree.
verse.verse_40: It is not permitted to the sun that it should overtake the moon, nor can the night outstrip the day: each in an orbit, they float.
verse.verse_41: And a sign Unto them is that We bear their offspring in a laden ship.
verse.verse_42: And We have created for them of the like thereUnto whereon they ride.
verse.verse_43: And if We list, We shall drown them, and there will be no shout for them, nor will they be saved.
verse.verse_44: unless it be a mercy from us, and as an enjoyment for a season.
verse.verse_45: And when it is said Unto them: fear that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy, they withdraw.
verse.verse_46: And not a sign cometh Unto them of the signs of their Lord, but they are ever backsliders therefrom.
verse.verse_47: And when it is said Unto them: expend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say Unto those who believe: shall we feed those whom God Himself would have fed, if He listed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
verse.verse_48: And they say: when will this promise be fulfilled if ye say sooth?
verse.verse_49: They await not but one shout, which shall lay hold of them while they are yet wrangling.
verse.verse_50: And they will not be able to make a disposition, nor to their family they return.
verse.verse_51: And the trumpet shall be blown, and lo! from the tombs Unto their Lord they shall be hastening.
verse.verse_52: They will say: Ah woe Unto us! who hath roused us from our sleeping-place? This is that which the Compassionate had promised, and truly spake the sent ones.
verse.verse_53: It shall be but one shout; and lo! they shall all be brought together before us.
verse.verse_54: To-day no soul will be wronged at all; nor shall ye be requited but for that which ye have been working.
verse.verse_55: Verily the fellows of the Garden to-day shall be happily employed.
verse.verse_56: They and their spouses, in shade on couches shall be reclining.
verse.verse_57: Theirs shall be fruit therein and theirs shall be whatsoever they ask for.
verse.verse_58: Peace shall be the word from the Lord Merciful.
verse.verse_59: And separate yourselves this Day, O ye culprits!
verse.verse_60: Enjoined I not on you, ye children of Adam, that ye shall not worship the Satan - verily he is Unto you manifest foe.
verse.verse_61: And that: ye shall worship Me; this is the straight path?
verse.verse_62: And yet assuredly he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Wherefore reflect ye not?
verse.verse_63: Yonder is Hell, which ye were promised.
verse.verse_64: Roast therein To-day for that ye have been disbelieving.
verse.verse_65: To-day We shall seal upon their mouths, and their hands will speak Unto us, and their feet will bear witness of that which they have been earning.
verse.verse_66: And if We listed, surely We should wipe out their eyes so that they would struggle for the way how then would they see?
verse.verse_67: And if We listed, surely We should transform them in their places, so that they would be able neither to go forward nor to return
verse.verse_68: And whomsoever We grant long life, We reverse him in creation. Reflect then they not?
verse.verse_69: And We have not taught him poetry, nor it befitteth him. This is but an admonition and a Recital luminous:
verse.verse_70: In order that it may warn him who is alive, and that the sentence may be justified on the infidels.
verse.verse_71: Observe they not that We have created for them, of that which Our hands have worked, cattle: so that they are their owners.
verse.verse_72: And We have subdued them Unto them, so that some of them they have for riding and on some of them they feed?
verse.verse_73: And they have therefrom other benefits and drinks. Will they not then give thanks?
verse.verse_74: And they have taken beside Allah gods, hoping that haply they may be succoured.
verse.verse_75: They are not able to give them succour; whereas they shall be against them host brought forward.
verse.verse_76: So let not their speech grieve thee. Verily We! We know whatsoever they keep secret and whatsoever they make known.
verse.verse_77: Beholdest not man that We have created him from a sperm? Yet lo! he is a manifest disputer?
verse.verse_78: And he propoundeth for us a similitude, and forgetteth his creation, He saith: who shall quicken the bones when they are decayed?
verse.verse_79: Say thou:" He shall quicken them Who brought them forth for the first time, and He is of every kind of creation the Knower!
verse.verse_80: Who giveth you out of the green tree fire, and lo! ye kindle therewith.
verse.verse_81: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of these? Yea! He is the Supreme Creator, the Knower.
verse.verse_82: His affair, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith Unto it: be, and it becometh.
verse.verse_83: Wherefore hallowed be He in whose hand is the governance of everything, and Unto whom ye shall be returned.
